name: io.github.chowdhurylab-studio/ipro-agent
title: IPRO protein redesign
description: Redesign a protein toward a stated goal: IPRO, with rotamer selection as a MILP

environmentVariables.name: IPRO_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a checkout of this repository. The documents the server offers as resources (ipro://skill, the operating manual, and the rest) ship with the repository rather than inside the package, so without this the server runs designs but serves no documents and tells the agent where to fetch them instead.

environmentVariables.name: IPRO_PYMOL_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to an interpreter that can import pymol, if it is not the one running the server. Rotamers come only from PyMOL's mutagenesis wizard and there is no fallback, so without a working PyMOL the server can validate, score positions and emit the integer program but cannot produce a design.

environmentVariables.name: IPRO_RUN_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Where detached runs write. Defaults to XDG_STATE_HOME or ~/.local/state/ipro-agent.
